## Highlights

**Convex ascent.** Added convex optimisation for gravity turns. No tuning is required: click EXECUTE and the rocket calculates a fuel-optimal ascent while satisfying constraints on dynamic pressure (q) and side loading (q·α). It is on by default with the CAT-S / UPFG ascent method.

**Landing fixes.**
- 6-DOF can now steer multi-stage craft. It was giving most of the pitch and yaw to the unlit engines of stages not yet fired, so those craft were stuck at a fixed tilt. They now land on target.
- When a 6-DOF landing stops short on a craft that can't throttle below its weight, G-FOLD now takes over instead of the craft climbing away.
